Stripe and PayPal present a polished facade of accessibility for digital commerce, but they inherently limit operations to a select number of countries. For example, while PayPal offers a user-friendly interface and integrated payment solutions, its reliance on a centralized system makes it prone to account suspensions, which can freeze funds for up to 180 days with no recourse. On the other hand, COREMERCH’s sovereign commerce infrastructure provides an alternative that is not only accessible to creators in Nigeria but allows them to own their entire digital store without dependency on third-party services. With a fully operational stack deployed in 48 hours and no hidden fees, creators can finally operate with true autonomy.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The exclusion of certain countries from Stripe and PayPal is more than just a limitation; it’s a structural barrier that leaves many creators without viable options. Stripe’s restrictions often stem from regulatory compliance and risk management, which inadvertently alienate large markets like Nigeria and Ghana. PayPal follows a similar path, enforcing account limitations based on geographic location. In contrast, COREMERCH is built to support creators from these very regions. By providing a sovereign commerce platform free from the pitfalls of centralized payment processing, creators can establish their businesses and engage with their customers directly without worrying about arbitrary account suspensions or fund holds.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, Stripe and PayPal tout fast transactions but often bury the costs associated with their services. Stripe charges around 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, which can add up significantly for small transactions. PayPal has similar fees and can also impose additional costs for currency conversions. In stark contrast, COREMERCH employs NOWPayments, which charges only a 0.5% fee for automatic cryptocurrency payment processing. This not only reduces transaction costs but also facilitates instant payment verification. By utilizing blockchain technology for payments, creators can access their funds immediately, avoiding the delays typically associated with traditional payment platforms.
Say goodbye to account suspensions and hello to ownership.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical factor often overlooked by creators when choosing their digital commerce solution. Stripe and PayPal operate on a rent-based model where users are dependent on their platforms, losing access to their accounts and funds at the platform's discretion. COREMERCH flips this model on its head, allowing users to own everything post-deployment. The infrastructure is designed for full automation, meaning product delivery is instantaneous and seamless without manual intervention. By integrating free tools like Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, creators ensure that they have complete control over their intellectual property and customer data while benefiting from automatic payment processing.

However, for those ready to scale and wanting more features, the Edge Commerce Stack provides robust infrastructure with enhanced capabilities. This includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations for email security, an essential feature for professional communication with customers. Ultimately, COREMERCH’s offering not only meets the requirements of creators in restricted countries but also provides a sustainable solution that allows for growth and autonomy.
